COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

2. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   B. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.

3. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   C. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.
   C. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Which statement about Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the .
   C. Treat Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  as rumours only.
   D. Say Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   C. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

10. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

12. Which statement about Community Needs is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Resource Mobilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Concept of Community Service Learning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Community Needs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
